name: Anisotropic Ambient Volume Shading
definition: An algorithm to visualize the anisotropy of volumetric features using anisotropic bidirectional reflectance distribution functions (BRDFs), solving the problem where isotropic specular highlights (like Blinn-Phong) do not support the perception of anisotropic features like elliptic or linear structures.
summary: Anisotropic Ambient Volume Shading improves shape perception by computing anisotropic specular highlights that align with local structural orientations, unlike isotropic models.
